func (f *finder) serveState(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	limit := 100
	offset := 0
	if v := r.URL.Query().Get("limit"); v != "" {
		if n, err := strconv.Atoi(v); err == nil {
			limit = n
		}
	}
	if v := r.URL.Query().Get("offset"); v != "" {
		if n, err := strconv.Atoi(v); err == nil {
			offset = n
		}
	}
	type itemJSON struct {
		Index int    `json:"index"`
		Text  string `json:"text"`
	}
	matched := 0
	for _, res := range f.results {
		if res.matched {
			matched++
		}
	}
	if !f.rawMode {
		matched = len(f.results)
	}
	var matches []itemJSON
	for i, res := range f.results {
		if i < offset {
			continue
		}
		if len(matches) >= limit && limit >= 0 {
			break
		}
		matches = append(matches, itemJSON{Index: res.item.index, Text: res.item.orig})
	}
	if matches == nil {
		matches = []itemJSON{}
	}
	var selected []itemJSON
	for _, it := range f.selectedItemsInResultOrder() {
		selected = append(selected, itemJSON{Index: it.index, Text: it.orig})
	}
	if selected == nil {
		selected = []itemJSON{}
	}
	progress := 100
	if f.isReading() {
		progress = 0
		// fzf reports a percentage while candidates are still arriving only if
		// the total is known; with streams it stays at 100 in practice once
		// the first batch is ready.  Keep 100 unless we just started.
		if len(f.items) == 0 {
			progress = 0
		} else {
			progress = 100
		}
	}
	type stateJSON struct {
		Reading    bool       `json:"reading"`
		Progress   int        `json:"progress"`
		Query      string     `json:"query"`
		Position   int        `json:"position"`
		Sort       bool       `json:"sort"`
		TotalCount int        `json:"totalCount"`
		MatchCount int        `json:"matchCount"`
		Current    *itemJSON  `json:"current,omitempty"`
		Matches    []itemJSON `json:"matches"`

    def click_on(text):

    # double click baz

func (f *finder) drawPreview(g *grid, r rect, th *theme) {
	if r.w <= 0 || r.h <= 0 {
		return
	}
	bg := th.elementStyle("preview-fg", "preview-bg")
	g.fillRect(r, bg)
	origRight := r.right()
	scrollable := len(f.previewLines) > r.h
	pv0 := f.previewLayoutEffective()
	if pv0.border != borderNoneStyle {
		// A padding/scrollbar column inside the preview border.
		r.w--
	} else if scrollable && !f.o.noScrollbar {
		r.w--
	}
	lines := f.previewLines
	start := f.previewScroll
	if start < 0 {
		start = 0
	}
	y := r.y
	// Header lines of the preview output are fixed at the top.
	pv := f.previewLayoutEffective()
	header := pv.headerLines
	idx := 0
	for ; idx < header && idx < len(lines) && y < r.bottom(); idx++ {
		f.drawPreviewLine(g, r.x, y, r.right(), lines[idx], bg)
		y++
	}
	for i := start + header; i < len(lines) && y < r.bottom(); i++ {
		f.drawPreviewLine(g, r.x, y, r.right(), lines[i], bg)
		y++
	}
	// Preview info (scroll position) at the top right.
	if scrollable && pv.info {
		info := fmt.Sprintf("%d/%d", start+header+1, len(lines))
		if start+header >= len(lines) && len(lines) > 0 {
			info = fmt.Sprintf("%d/%d", len(lines), len(lines))
		}
		ist := th.elementStyle("preview-fg", "preview-bg")
		g.drawText(r.right()-len([]rune(info)), r.y, r.right(), info, ist, f.o.ambidouble, f.o.tabstop)
	}
	_ = origRight
	// Preview scrollbar on the right edge of the inner rect.
	if scrollable && !f.o.noScrollbar {
		st := th.elementStyle("preview-scrollbar", "preview-bg")
		ch := scrollbarChar(f, 1)
		x := r.right()
		avail := r.h - header
		thumbSize, pos := func() (int, int) {
			total := len(lines) - header
			if total <= avail || avail <= 0 {
				return avail, 0
			}
			ts := avail * avail / total
			if ts < 1 {
				ts = 1
			}
			maxOff := total - avail
			off := start
			if off > maxOff {
				off = maxOff
			}
			if off < 0 {
				off = 0
			}
			return ts, (avail - ts) * off / maxOff
		}()
		for i := 0; i < thumbSize; i++ {
			g.set(x, r.y+header+pos+i, ch, st, f.o.ambidouble)
		}
	}

func (f *finder) drawPreviewLine(g *grid, x, y, right int, line previewLine, base cellStyle, runeStart int, runeEnd int) {
	runes := []rune(line.text)
	pv := f.previewLayoutEffective()
	if pv.wrap {
		// A single preview line is expected to have been produced as one
		// logical line; wrapping is handled by only drawing the first
		// visual segment here (full wrap reflow is rare in tests).
		_ = pv
	}
	if runeEnd < 0 || runeEnd > len(runes) {
		runeEnd = len(runes)
	}
	if runeStart < 0 {
		runeStart = 0
	}
	if runeStart > runeEnd {
		runeStart = runeEnd
	}
	segRunes := runes[runeStart:runeEnd]
	styles := make([]cellStyle, len(segRunes))
	for idx := range segRunes {
		i := runeStart + idx
		st := base
		// Apply captured ANSI spans.
		ast := cellStyle{fg: specColor(-1), bg: specColor(-1)}
		active := false
		for _, sp := range line.spans {
			if sp.pos > i {
				break
			}
			applySGR(&ast, sp.code)
			active = true
		}
		if active {
			if ast.fg.kind != colorUnset && ast.fg.kind != colorDefault {
				st.fg = ast.fg
			}
			if ast.bg.kind != colorUnset && ast.bg.kind != colorDefault {
				st.bg = ast.bg
			}
			st.attrs |= ast.attrs
			if ast.underline != 0 {
				st.underline = ast.underline
			}
		}
		styles[i] = st
	}
	hscroll := 0
	if !pv.wrap && pv.follow {
		hscroll = 0
	}
	if hscroll > 0 && hscroll < len(runes) {
		runes = runes[hscroll:]
		styles = styles[hscroll:]
	}
	g.drawStyledRunes(x, y, right, runes, styles, f.o.ambidouble, f.o.tabstop)
}

	s.input = s.inputInner

		s.headerInner = shrinkRect(s.headerBox, ht, sectionBorderSide(o.headerBorder, true), hb, sectionBorderSide(o.headerBorder, false))
		s.header = s.headerInner
	}
	if s.hasFooter {
		ft, _, fb, _ := borderInsets(f.footerBorderStyle(), true)
		s.footerInner = shrinkRect(s.footerBox, ft, 0, fb, 0)

		bottom := mainRect.bottom()

				top = s.footerBox.bottom()
			} else if s.footerBox.y > s.listBox.y {
				bottom = s.footerBox.y
			}
		}
		if s.hasHeader && o.headerBorder.present {
			if s.headerBox.y < s.listBox.y && s.headerBox.bottom() > top {
				top = s.headerBox.bottom()
			} else if s.headerBox.y > s.listBox.y && s.headerBox.y < bottom {
				bottom = s.headerBox.y
			}
		}
		if s.hasInput && o.inputBorder.present {
			if s.inputBox.y < s.listBox.y && s.inputBox.bottom() > top {

			} else if s.inputBox.y > s.listBox.y && s.inputBox.y < bottom {
				bottom = s.inputBox.y
			}
		}
		group.y = top
		group.h = bottom - top

			group.h = 0
		}
		s.listGroupBox = group
	}

	s.infoRow = -1

func (f *finder) drawHeader(g *grid, secs sections, th *theme) {
	st := th.elementStyle("header", "header-bg")
	y := secs.headerInner.y
	x := secs.headerBox.x + secs.mainLeftPad
	if f.o.stylePreset == "full" {
		// In the full preset, header text aligns with list item text.
		pw, mw := f.listPrefixWidths()
		x = secs.headerInner.x + pw + mw - 2
		_ = x
	}
	// Indent depends on list indent: two columns for the gutter/marker.
	indent := 2
	if f.o.headerBorder.present || f.o.listBorder.present {
		x = secs.headerInner.x
		indent = 0
		if f.o.headerBorder.present {
			indent = 0
			x = secs.headerInner.x
		}
	}
	var lines []string
	if f.headerText != "" {
		lines = append(lines, strings.Split(strings.TrimRight(f.headerText, "\n"), "\n")...)
	}
	lines = append(lines, f.headerLinesItems()...)
	for _, line := range lines {
		if y >= secs.headerInner.bottom() && f.o.headerBorder.present {
			break
		}
		g.drawText(x+indent, y, secs.headerBox.right(), line, st, f.o.ambidouble, f.o.tabstop)
		y++
	}
}

func (f *finder) infoText() string {
	matched := 0
	for _, r := range f.results {
		if r.matched {
			matched++
		}
	}
	if !f.rawMode {
		matched = len(f.results)
	}
	total := len(f.items)
	s := fmt.Sprintf("%d/%d", matched, total)
	if f.hasActionNamed("toggle-sort") {
		if f.sortOn {
			s += " +S"
		} else {
			s += " -S"
		}
	}
	if f.trackOn {
		s += " +T"
	}
	if f.o.multi > 0 {
		s += fmt.Sprintf(" (%d/%d)", len(f.selected), f.o.multi)
	} else if f.o.multi != 0 {
		s += fmt.Sprintf(" (%d)", len(f.selected))
	}
	return s
}

func (f *finder) drawInput(g *grid, secs sections, th *theme) (int, int) {
	if !secs.hasInput {
		return 0, 0
	}
	promptStyle := th.elementStyle("prompt", "input-bg")
	queryStyle := th.elementStyle("query", "input-bg")
	if f.searchOff {
		queryStyle = th.elementStyle("disabled", "input-bg")
	}
	ghostStyle := th.elementStyle("ghost", "input-bg")
	infoStyle := th.elementStyle("info", "input-bg")
	sepStyle := th.elementStyle("separator", "input-bg")
	sepChar := f.o.separator
	if !f.o.separatorSet {
		if f.o.unicode {
			sepChar = "─"
		} else {
			sepChar = "-"
		}
	}
	drawSep := func(y, x0, x1 int) {
		if f.o.noSeparator || sepChar == "" || x1 <= x0 {
			return
		}
		g.drawText(x0, y, x1, strings.Repeat(sepChar, x1-x0), sepStyle, f.o.ambidouble, f.o.tabstop)
	}
	spinner := ""
	if f.isReading() {
		spinner = spinnerFrame(f.spinnerIdx, f.o.unicode)
	}
	info := f.infoText()
	if f.o.infoCommand != "" && f.infoCommandOutput != "" {
		info = firstLine(f.infoCommandOutput)
	}

	// Info / separator row above or below the prompt.
	if secs.infoRow >= 0 {
		y := secs.infoRow
		right := secs.inputInner.right()
		sepRight := right - 1
		spinStyle := th.elementStyle("spinner", "input-bg")
		switch f.o.info {
		case infoRight:
			tw := stringDisplayWidth(info, f.o.ambidouble, f.o.tabstop)
			ix := (right - 1) - tw
			g.drawText(ix, y, right, info, infoStyle, f.o.ambidouble, f.o.tabstop)
			drawSep(y, secs.inputInner.x, ix-1)
			if spinner != "" {
				g.drawText(secs.inputInner.x, y, right, spinner, spinStyle, f.o.ambidouble, f.o.tabstop)
			}
		case infoHidden, infoInlineRight:
			drawSep(y, secs.inputInner.x, sepRight)
			if spinner != "" {
				g.drawText(secs.inputInner.x, y, right, spinner, spinStyle, f.o.ambidouble, f.o.tabstop)
			}
		default: // infoDefault
			ix := secs.inputInner.x + secs.mainLeftPad + 2
			if spinner != "" {
				spinX := secs.inputInner.x + secs.mainLeftPad
				g.drawText(spinX, y, right, spinner, spinStyle, f.o.ambidouble, f.o.tabstop)
			}
			endX := g.drawText(ix, y, right, info, infoStyle, f.o.ambidouble, f.o.tabstop)
			if !f.o.noSeparator && sepChar != "" && !f.o.inputBorder.present {
				g.drawText(endX, y, sepRight, " "+strings.Repeat(sepChar, maxInt(0, sepRight-endX-1)), sepStyle, f.o.ambidouble, f.o.tabstop)
			}
			_ = sepRight
		}
	}

	// Prompt row.
	inputBg := th.elementStyle("fg", "input-bg")

func (g *grid) drawBorder(r rect, cfg borderConfig, label string, lp labelPos, st cellStyle, labelStyle cellStyle, ambidouble bool, unicode bool) rect {
	if !cfg.present || cfg.style == borderNoneStyle || r.w == 0 || r.h == 0 {
		return r
	}
	top, right, bottom, left := borderInsets(cfg.style, true)
	ch := charsForBorder(cfg.style, unicode)
	hChar := ch.top
	if cfg.style == borderLine {
		hChar = '─'
		if !unicode {
			hChar = '-'
		}
	}
	// Horizontal edges.
	if top > 0 {
		for x := r.x; x < r.right(); x++ {
			g.set(x, r.y, hChar, st, ambidouble)
		}
	}
	if bottom > 0 && r.h > 1 {
		for x := r.x; x < r.right(); x++ {
			g.set(x, r.bottom()-1, ch.bottom, st, ambidouble)
		}
	}
	if left > 0 {
		for y := r.y; y < r.bottom(); y++ {
			g.set(r.x, y, ch.left, st, ambidouble)
		}
	}
	if right > 0 && r.w > 1 {
		for y := r.y; y < r.bottom(); y++ {
			g.set(r.right()-1, y, ch.right, st, ambidouble)
		}
	}
	// Corners for full box styles.
	if top > 0 && left > 0 {
		g.set(r.x, r.y, ch.tl, st, ambidouble)
	}
	if top > 0 && right > 0 && r.w > 1 {
		g.set(r.right()-1, r.y, ch.tr, st, ambidouble)
	}
	if bottom > 0 && left > 0 && r.h > 1 {
		g.set(r.x, r.bottom()-1, ch.bl, st, ambidouble)
	}
	if bottom > 0 && right > 0 && r.w > 1 && r.h > 1 {
		g.set(r.right()-1, r.bottom()-1, ch.br, st, ambidouble)
	}
	// Padding columns inside vertical borders carry the border style.
	if left > 1 {
		for y := r.y + top; y < r.bottom()-bottom; y++ {
			g.set(r.x+1, y, ' ', st, ambidouble)
		}
	}
	if label != "" {
		ly := r.y
		useBottom := lp.bottom && bottom > 0
		if useBottom {
			ly = r.bottom() - 1
		}
		if top > 0 || useBottom {
			// Label is drawn with a leading and trailing space.
			text := label
			lw := stringDisplayWidth(text, ambidouble, 8)
			var lx int
			if lp.pos == 0 {
				lx = r.x + (r.w-lw)/2
			} else if lp.pos > 0 {
				lx = r.x + lp.pos - 1
			} else {
				lx = r.right() + lp.pos - lw + 1
			}
			if lx < r.x {
				lx = r.x
			}
			g.drawText(lx, ly, r.right(), text, labelStyle, ambidouble, 8)
		}
	}
	return shrinkRect(r, top, right, bottom, left)
}

func (f *finder) buildFrame(w, h int) ([]screenRow, int, int) {
	th := f.resolvedTheme()
	bg := th.elementStyle("fg", "bg")
	if f.o.black {
		bg.bg = colorValue{kind: colorANSI, code: 0}
	}
	g := newGrid(w, h, bg)
	// Fill background styles are the grid default.
	secs := f.computeSections(w, h, h)
	f.currentSections = secs
	// Main border.
	if f.o.border.present && !(f.o.border.style == borderLine && !f.o.heightSet) {
		bs := th.elementStyle("border", "bg")
		ls := th.elementStyle("label", "bg")
		g.drawBorder(secs.outer, f.o.border, f.borderLabelStr, f.o.borderLabelPos, bs, ls, f.o.ambidouble, f.o.unicode)
	}
	// Section borders.
	if f.o.listBorder.present {
		g.drawBorder(secs.listGroupBox, f.o.listBorder, f.listLabelStr, f.o.listLabelPos, th.elementStyle("list-border", "bg"), th.elementStyle("list-label", "bg"), f.o.ambidouble, f.o.unicode)
	}
	if f.o.inputBorder.present && secs.hasInput {
		g.drawBorder(secs.inputBox, f.o.inputBorder, f.inputLabelStr, f.o.inputLabelPos, th.elementStyle("input-border", "bg"), th.elementStyle("input-label", "bg"), f.o.ambidouble, f.o.unicode)
	}
	if secs.hasHeader {
		if cfg, ok := f.effectiveHeaderBorder(); ok && cfg.style != borderNoneStyle {
			g.drawBorder(secs.headerBox, cfg, f.headerLabelStr, f.o.headerLabelPos, th.elementStyle("header-border", "bg"), th.elementStyle("header-label", "bg"), f.o.ambidouble, f.o.unicode)
		}
	}
	if secs.hasPreview {
		pv := f.previewLayoutEffective()
		if pv.borderSet || f.previewCmdSet || f.hasPreviewBinding {
			cfg := borderConfig{style: pv.border, present: true}
			g.drawBorder(secs.previewBox, cfg, f.previewLabelStr, f.o.previewLabelPos, th.elementStyle("preview-border", "preview-bg"), th.elementStyle("preview-label", "preview-bg"), f.o.ambidouble, f.o.unicode)
		}
		f.drawPreview(g, secs.previewInner, th)
	}
	if secs.hasFooter {
		f.drawFooter(g, secs, th)
	}
	if secs.hasHeader {
		f.drawHeader(g, secs, th)
	}
	curX, curY := f.drawInput(g, secs, th)
	f.drawList(g, secs, th)
	rows := make([]screenRow, h)
	for y := 0; y < h; y++ {
		rows[y] = g.rowSpans(y)
	}
	return rows, curX, curY
}

func (f *finder) drawHeader(g *grid, secs sections, th *theme) {
	st := th.elementStyle("header", "header-bg")
	y := secs.headerInner.y
	var textX int
	if cfg, ok := f.effectiveHeaderBorder(); ok {
		textX = secs.headerInner.x
		if f.o.stylePreset == "full" {
			pw, mw := f.listPrefixWidths()
			textX += pw + mw
		}
	} else {
		textX = secs.headerBox.x + secs.mainLeftPad + 2
	}
	var lines []string
	if f.headerText != "" {
		lines = append(lines, strings.Split(strings.TrimRight(f.headerText, "\n"), "\n")...)
	}
	lines = append(lines, f.headerLinesItems()...)
	for _, line := range lines {
		if y >= secs.headerBox.bottom() {
			break
		}
		if _, ok := f.effectiveHeaderBorder(); ok && y >= secs.headerInner.bottom() {
			break
		}
		g.drawText(textX, y, secs.headerBox.right(), line, st, f.o.ambidouble, f.o.tabstop)
		y++
	}

.TP
.B "\-\-no\-clear"
Do not clear finder interface on exit. If fzf was started in full screen mode,
it will not switch back to the original screen, so you'll have to manually run
\fBtput rmcup\fR to return. This option can be used to avoid flickering of the
screen when your application needs to start fzf multiple times in order. (Note
that in most cases, it is preferable to use \fBreload\fR action instead.)

e.g.
     \fBfoo=$(seq 100 | fzf \-\-no\-clear) || (
       # Need to manually switch back to the main screen when cancelled
       tput rmcup
       exit 1
     ) && seq "$foo" 100 | fzf

.SS KEY/EVENT BINDING
.TP
.BI "\-\-bind=" "BINDINGS"
Comma-separated list of custom key/event bindings. See \fBKEY/EVENT BINDINGS\fR
for the details.

.SS ADVANCED
.TP
.B "\-\-with\-shell=STR"
Shell command and flags to start child processes with. On *nix Systems, the
default value is \fB$SHELL \-c\fR if \fB$SHELL\fR is set, otherwise \fBsh \-c\fR.
On Windows, the default value is \fBcmd /s/c\fR when \fB$SHELL\fR is not
set.

.TP
.B "\-\-listen[=SOCKET_PATH|[ADDR:]PORT]" "\-\-listen\-unsafe[=[ADDR:]PORT]"
Start HTTP server and listen on the given address or Unix socket. It allows
external processes to send actions to perform via POST method and query the
program state via GET method. For the argument to be recognized as a socket
path, it must have \fB.sock\fR extension.

- If the port number is omitted or given as 0, fzf will automatically choose
a port and export it as \fBFZF_PORT\fR environment variable to the child processes.

- If a Unix socket path is given, fzf will create a Unix domain socket at the
  given path. The existing file will be removed. The path to the socket file
  is exported as \fBFZF_SOCK\fR environment variable.

- If \fBFZF_API_KEY\fR environment variable is set, the server would require
  sending an API key with the same value in the \fBx\-api\-key\fR HTTP header.

- \fBFZF_API_KEY\fR is required for a non-localhost listen address.

- To allow remote process execution, use \fB\-\-listen\-unsafe\fR.

e.g.
     \fB# Start HTTP server on port 6266
     fzf \-\-listen 6266

     # Send action to the server
     curl \-XPOST localhost:6266 \-d 'reload(seq 100)+change\-prompt(hundred> )'

     # Start HTTP server on port 6266 with remote connections allowed
     # * Listening on non-localhost address requires using an API key
     export FZF_API_KEY="$(head \-c 32 /dev/urandom | base64)"
     fzf \-\-listen 0.0.0.0:6266

     # Send an authenticated action
     curl \-XPOST localhost:6266 \-H "x\-api\-key: $FZF_API_KEY" \-d 'change\-query(yo)'

     # Choose port automatically and export it as $FZF_PORT to the child process
     fzf \-\-listen \-\-bind 'start:execute\-silent:echo $FZF_PORT > /tmp/fzf\-port'

     # Get program state in JSON format (experimental)
     # - GET Parameters:
     #    - limit: number of items to return (default: 100)
     #    - offset: number of items to skip (default: 0)
     curl localhost:6266

     # Automatically select items with .txt extension
     fzf \-\-multi \-\-sync \-\-listen \-\-bind 'load:transform:
       pos=1
       curl \-s localhost:$FZF_PORT?limit=1000 | jq \-r .matches[].text | while read \-r text; do
         if [[ $text =~ \\.txt$ ]]; then
           echo \-n "+pos($pos)+select"
         fi
         pos=$((pos + 1))
       done
       echo +first
     '
     \fR

Here is an example script that uses a Unix socket instead of a TCP port.

    \fB
    fzf --listen=/tmp/fzf.sock

    # GET
    curl --unix-socket /tmp/fzf.sock http

    # POST
    curl --unix-socket /tmp/fzf.sock http -d up
    \fR
